name: Maricopa County Project Baccara MCP250007 Board Hearing Agenda And Conditions
update_frequency: Project plan, permit, construction, and occupancy milestones
known_limitations: The official Board hearing agenda records MCP250007, the recommended conditions, and the downstream plan, service, air, fire, military, building, water, and occupancy requirements. Maricopa County states that agenda documents are not fully executed records, so the vote outcome is corroborated separately and the agenda does not prove compliance with any condition.
source_owner: Maricopa County Planning and Development Department
automation_notes: Track the fully executed MCP record, precise Plan of Development, annexation or water and sewer service record, Military Compatibility Compliance Report, air permit, building permits, fire approvals, construction, and certificate of occupancy. Do not treat the hearing agenda as proof that a condition has been satisfied.
notes: Phase 55C downstream permit record. The May 6, 2026 agenda sets out conditions a-p for Project Baccara, including a pre-annexation service agreement or provider will-serve letter, a later Plan of Development before construction permits, fire approvals, Luke Air Force Base compliance evidence, an air permit, DoD review, final engineering, water-system approvals, and later building and occupancy steps.
